company_name: Jin Zhou East Quartz Material Science and Technology
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in quartz glass products that are essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Jin Zhou East Quartz Material Science and Technology is a leading manufacturer of quartz glass products used in the semiconductor industry. Their offerings include quartz ingots, tubes, plates, and crucibles, which are critical components in semiconductor and LCD manufacturing as well as other high-tech applications.
capabilities: Quartz ingots and blocks for semiconductor applications
Quartz tubes and rods for manufacturing equipment
Quartz plates and discs for photomasks

regional_presence.China: The company is based in China and serves a global customer base.
